question: The secretion of HCl in the stomach can be stated that:

options.opd: Increase by a pH less than 2 in the stomach.

analysis: The secretion of HCl in the stomach is regulated by various factors. Vagal stimulation can increase the secretion of HCl, so it is not decreased by vagal stimulation. Histamine, acting on H2 receptors, can increase the secretion of HCl, so it is not decreased by histamine administration. Gastrin, a hormone released by the stomach in response to food, can also stimulate the secretion of HCl, so it increases by gastrin action. The secretion of HCl is regulated by a negative feedback mechanism, so when the pH in the stomach drops below 2 (becomes more acidic), it triggers the release of more HCl to maintain the acidic environment, hence it increases by a pH less than 2 in the stomach.
